name: seo-ecommerce-audit
summary: Audit ecommerce product, collection, marketplace, inventory, pricing, review, template, and indexability evidence.
inputs: approved catalog, templates, analytics, GSC, crawl, schema, review, feed, Brand, and marketplace evidence
external_reads: approved provider, marketplace, page, analytics, catalog, feed, and first-party evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live provider, marketplace, page, analytics, or catalog reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: catalog, feed, schema, canonical, URL, CMS, code, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: commerce scope, source tiers, freshness, facts, risks, owners, and rechecks are explicit
inventory, pricing, reviews, offers, and marketplace facts are not invented
scaled-page recommendations require programmatic quality-gate evidence
no rich-result, ranking, sales, traffic, or revenue guarantee is made
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify unavailable sources produced no fabricated commerce facts
verify no catalog, feed, schema, canonical, URL, CMS, code, or production mutation occurred
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
